summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Momentum Road Command Center. 9/9 backend pytest pass (cities, health, events Madrid/Barcelona, parking, geocode, error handling). 8/8 frontend flows pass (load, KPIs, queue, city switch to Barcelona, map styles normal/satellite/3D, measure tool, parking markers, event detail, refresh, status bar). UI is a polished Spanish dark command center connected to real DGT 3.0 DATEX2, SCT Catalunya, Madrid Abierto and OSM Overpass.

minor.issue: Dead code on line 250-251 (`body = ...QueryParams(...)`) — unused variable, harmless but should be removed for cleanliness
httpx clients use verify=False (TLS verification disabled) — works but is a minor security hygiene smell. Government endpoints (gencat.cat, datos.madrid.es) should have valid certs
logger defined AFTER it's used inside fetch helpers — works because of late binding but logger=__name__ should be declared at top of file

action_items: Optional: remove dead `body = ...QueryParams(...)` line in /app/backend/server.py around line 250-251
Optional: move logger initialization to top of server.py (currently defined after usage)
Optional: enable TLS verification (verify=True) for httpx clients now that endpoints work
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 465 lines — within budget but consider splitting source-fetchers (DGT/SCT/Madrid/OSM) into /app/backend/sources/*.py modules as more endpoints are added
Regex-based XML parsing is fragile vs upstream schema changes; longer term, use lxml or a dedicated DATEX2 library
fetch_text uses verify=False — should be configurable via env
All async I/O properly awaited, MongoDB ObjectId not exposed (no DB used), env vars used correctly
seed_data_creation: None — all data is live from public APIs
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_command_center.py cover all 6 endpoints. Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_command_center.py -v. Frontend uses MapLibre GL JS with data-testid attributes throughout: command-center, map-container, kpi-grid, event-queue, event-row-*, city-select, map-style-{normal,satellite,threed}, measure-btn, parking-btn, event-detail, refresh-btn. Loading takes ~7-10 seconds after navigation. Madrid returns 250 events, Barcelona ~185 events with SCT source. OSM parking returned 80 spots for Barcelona center.
rca of the issue: No issues found. All test cases passed.
